interaction.content: Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been taking up most of your mind lately?
I keep thinking that I have a weak heart / that I’m emotionally weak.
Each time that thought comes up, it’s become a moment for you to look back at yourself.
Yes, as I look back on myself, I keep wondering why I’m so emotionally weak and how I can become stronger.
When you say becoming emotionally stronger, what does that specifically mean to you?
It means being able to recover quickly when I’m hurt or disappointed, and being able to try new challenges without fear.
You have a clear goal for your personal growth.
Yes, so I’ve been thinking about what concrete steps I should take to reach that goal.
Considering those concrete steps also seems like a part of your growth.
In fact, lately I’ve been trying little by little to meet people.
Your effort to actively take part in social situations will likely help build your confidence.
I’m hoping so too.
When you try to meet people, what kinds of activities are you most interested in?
I like reading books, so I’m thinking of joining a book club.
Joining a book club sounds like a good direction for a new beginning.
Hearing you say that gives me a bit of courage.
Sharing experiences with others and broadening your understanding is an important part of growing.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been taking up most of your mind lately?
I’ve lost a lot of interest in things around me. The passion I used to have for meeting friends or starting something new is gone.
So you’ve been someone who used to throw yourself into many things with a lot of passion.
Yes, I was. But now, no matter what I start, it’s hard to find any meaning in it.
Could you share what first triggered that feeling for you?
Honestly, I don’t really know exactly when it started. Everything just started to feel unimportant to me.
You’re saying that in many areas of your life, things no longer feel important.
Yes, that’s right. Just getting through each day feels like an assignment.
It sounds like all the activities in your daily life have turned into a kind of burden.
Exactly. Every daily activity feels like a heavy load.
You’re saying that these activities feel like a heavy burden to you.
Yes, I’ve lost all motivation for anything, and only the sense of burden keeps getting bigger.
If there were a way to lessen this burden, even just a little, what do you think it might be?
I’d like to start with something very small where I can at least feel a sense of accomplishment.
So you’re thinking you’d like to feel a sense of accomplishment starting from very small things.
Yes, and I want to look for those kinds of things that can give me that sense of accomplishment.
You’d like to find things that can give you a sense of accomplishment.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been on your mind lately?
Hello. Lately I’ve been thinking a lot about my relationship with my mom in my life. She often says things that feel like she’s blaming me, and that becomes a big source of stress for me.
So you’re feeling quite a bit of stress because of your relationship with your mom.
Yes, especially when my mom gets angry and blames me, that’s the hardest part.
It sounds really difficult to be in a situation where her anger is directed at you and you end up feeling responsible.
It really is. Every time my mom blames me, I find myself doubting myself without even realizing it.
What would you like to see improve in your relationship with your mom?
I hope that between my mom and me, we can have a relationship where we respect and understand each other.
Your wish to pursue mutual respect and understanding in your relationship with your mom is very important.
I wish I could have the courage to express my thoughts to my mom, even if it’s just little by little.
In what way would you like to try expressing your thoughts to your mom?
I want to talk honestly about the problems that come up in our relationship.
Talking honestly about the problems could really help improve the relationship.
Yes, through honest conversations, I want us to clear up misunderstandings and work on improving our relationship.
As you prepare for an honest conversation, what is the first topic you’d most like to talk about?
I’d like to start with aligning our expectations of each other.
Your intention to align expectations of each other could be the first step toward better communication.
Hello, could we talk about what has had the biggest psychological impact on you recently?
After failing the teacher certification exam, as I went back to preparing for it again, I started to feel like I was really isolated.
It sounds like a lot of different emotions must have come up for you in that process.
Yes, especially because it feels like everyone around me is moving forward on their own path, so I feel more and more like I’m the only one being left behind.
You feel that you’re falling behind compared to the people around you.
Yes. Even when I try not to compare myself, my situation keeps looking so small and pathetic to me.
You keep comparing yourself to others, and as a result you’re feeling like your situation is insignificant and shabby.
When I think like that, I feel even more lonely and exhausted.
So the loneliness and the difficulty are stemming from those thoughts.
Yes, so the feeling that I’m all alone gets stronger.
You’re struggling with the feeling of being alone getting stronger and stronger.
Yes, and I feel like this situation is wearing me out even more.
You feel that the exhaustion and how hard this is are getting worse in this situation.
Yes, more than anything, I just want to get away from all this sense of burden and pressure.
You have a strong wish to be free from that burden and pressure.
Hello, what emotion do you find yourself feeling most often these days?
I’m sorry to say this, but I most often feel frustrated and powerless.
Thank you for honestly sharing those feelings.
I keep making the same mistakes over and over, and I’m disappointed in myself for not changing.
You’re really feeling a strong sense of disappointment about these repeated mistakes.
Yes, and I think that disappointment makes me feel even more drained and helpless.
You’re noticing that the disappointment is leading into that sense of helplessness.
I think it would be good if I tried harder to understand myself better.
Trying to understand yourself is a very courageous step.
Thank you. I feel like the more I understand myself, the more I’ll be able to move in a better direction.
What kinds of things would you like to try in order to understand yourself better?
First, I want to analyze why I keep putting things off.
The fact that you want to analyze the reasons you procrastinate shows a real willingness to work on the problem.
After I figure out the reasons, I’d like to start with small goals to reduce my procrastination.
It’s impressive that you’re making a concrete plan to address the problem and that you’re willing to put it into action.
I’m starting to believe that even if the goals are small for now, I can bring about gradual change by achieving them.
So you’re beginning to develop a belief that you can create gradual change by achieving those small goals.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been staying in your mind most often lately?
Stress and loneliness from my relationships with people are taking up most of my mind.
It sounds like you’ve been thinking a lot about how to relate to people and how to be within those relationships.
Yes, because of that, I decided to look back on myself and try to find a new hobby.
Is there a change or a feeling you’re hoping to gain through this new hobby?
Yes, by starting a new hobby, I want to reduce my stress even a little and spend my time alone in a more meaningful way.
When you spend your time alone in a fulfilling way, what would you like to feel?
I want to feel satisfaction and happiness with myself.
So you’d like to feel satisfied and happy with yourself.
Yes, and through having my own time, I want to understand my emotions better.
When you’re trying to understand your emotions better, what kind of activities do you think might help you?
I think activities like reading books or trying some writing would probably help.
Between reading and writing, which would you like to try first?
I’d like to try writing first.
I can see that you want to explore your emotions through writing.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been taking up most of your mind these days?
Every day my heart feels heavy, and I’m really worried about my future.
Even while things feel heavy and you’re carrying a lot of worry, sharing it like this is an important step.
Maybe because of that, I get easily depressed and anxious over even small things.
So even small things are making you feel depressed and anxious.
Yes, and that anxiety and depressed feeling are affecting my studies, my daily life, and even my health.
So the anxiety and depressed mood are affecting your studies, your life, and even your health.
I want to make this situation even a little bit better.
I’d like to hear what kinds of changes you’d like to experience in this situation.
I want to learn how to manage my stress.
So you’re saying you’d like to learn ways to manage your stress.
Yes, I think that’s the first step I need right now.
You already have thoughts about moving toward change.
I think if I could be a bit more relaxed and gentle with myself, I’d be happier.
So you think that if you can give yourself more room and be more at ease, you’ll be able to feel happiness.
Thinking this way, I feel like my heart is getting a little lighter.
As you share your thoughts, you’re experiencing your heart feeling a bit lighter.
Hello. Was there something in particular that led you to come in today?
Hello. Recently I’ve been noticing that I keep failing to do the things I’m supposed to do properly, and I’ve been feeling really frustrated with myself.
That frustration you felt in those moments must have been pretty intense.
Yes, it’s having a big impact on my daily life.
It sounds like your daily life is being affected quite a lot, and you’re feeling a burden because of that.
Yes, the burden feels heavy, and even though I want to fix it, I don’t know what to do.
You do have the will to work on it, but you haven’t been able to find a way yet.
Yes, I honestly have no idea where or how I’m supposed to start.
So you’re feeling at a loss about where to begin.
Yes, I think it would help if I could gain even a little bit of insight about it.
So you have a desire to gain some insight.
Yes, I want to understand my situation more concretely.
Your effort to understand your situation more concretely is becoming an important first step.
Your desire to improve this situation is getting stronger and stronger.
You have a strong motivation to improve your situation.
Yes, that’s why I came here.
Thank you for coming here and talking about what’s going on for you right now.
Hello, what’s been lingering on your mind lately?
I feel heavy about the major I chose.
So you’ve been thinking a lot about the field you’re studying now.
Yes, I’m not sure if it’s something I’m truly interested in.
Could you tell me in more detail which parts you’re unsure about?
I was very interested in design, but because of practical issues I chose tourism as my major.
So now you’re struggling between reality and your interests.
Yes. I sometimes regret that I gave up what I was interested in when I ran into the wall of reality.
Even amid regret and confusion, you have the courage to face your own feelings.
Even if I try to think of it that way, it’s really hard.
What kind of help or guidance do you think might be useful in getting through your current situation?
I want to know how to find what I truly want and how to move in that direction.
Your attempt to discover what you long for can become the starting point of your journey.
But even just finding that starting point feels overwhelming.
So finding the starting point feels difficult for you.
Yes, I think it’s because I keep feeling lost and it’s hard to find a direction.
I understand the feelings that come up when your worries are big and it’s not easy to find your direction.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been taking up most of your mind lately?
These days I honestly don’t know what I’m supposed to do. I know I should study, but it’s so hard to get started.
Could you tell me more specifically what makes it hard to start studying?
I can’t really concentrate, and whenever I try to start something, the anxious feeling gets bigger.
It sounds like the difficulty concentrating and the anxiety keep getting in your way.
Yeah, and it’s even harder because I feel like my family is disappointed in me.
You’re struggling between wanting to live up to your family’s expectations and feeling pressured that you might not meet them.
Yes, and lately it feels like that pressure is pushing me into an even darker corner.
What have you tried, if anything, to ease that pressure, even just a little?
To be honest, I haven’t really tried anything specific yet.
When you’re faced with that pressure, what kind of approach would you like to try?
I’d like to set small goals and try to achieve them one by one.
So you’d like to set small goals and accomplish them.
Yes, I think if I do that, I might gradually be able to overcome my anxiety.
It sounds like your way of overcoming your anxiety is already taking shape as a concrete, realistic plan.
Hello, what’s been going on for you recently?
Hello, actually I’ve been having a really hard time lately because of my relationship with my parents.
It sounds like that situation is having a big impact on you.
Yes, that’s right. This situation is a huge burden on me.
Your relationship with your parents feels psychologically very difficult right now.
It really does. I keep clashing with my parents, and I feel like they don’t understand me.
It seems like the conflicts in opinions are deepening the misunderstandings.
Yes, that’s exactly it. Even when I try to express my thoughts or feelings, it feels like they don’t really listen.
Because communication isn’t going smoothly, your heart feels really heavy and exhausted.
That’s exactly how it is. The lack of communication is making me feel even more suffocated.
It seems like the frustration that comes from not being able to communicate well is growing.
Yes, I also want things to change.
I’m really struck by how you’re trying to work toward change.
I want to try doing something myself to improve this situation.
Your effort to find a direction forward feels very solid.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been filling your mind lately?
I often feel like I’m falling behind when I see other people’s achievements.
That feeling can be quite heavy to carry.
Yeah, honestly, I just feel so small and insignificant.
You’re evaluating yourself more harshly by comparing yourself to others.
Yes, that comparison makes me feel even smaller.
Comparison can sometimes become a prison that traps us.
Thinking about it that way, I feel like I should try to get out of that comparison.
It couldn’t have been easy to decide to stop comparing yourself, and I really want to acknowledge that courage.
Thank you. But I feel lost about how to actually put that decision into practice.
Is there any approach you’d like to try to help you stop comparing yourself?
I’m going to try to focus only on what’s been given to me to do.
Making an effort to focus on what’s in front of you is a very positive attitude.
Yes, instead of comparing myself to others, I want to focus on my own growth.
Your choice to focus on your own growth will be an important step forward.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts or feelings have been weighing on you the most lately?
These days, there are many times when I don’t feel good when I’m with people.
I see. It sounds like something has changed about how it feels to be with people compared to before.
Yeah, I feel like I don’t get any energy from being around people anymore.
So when you’re with people, you’re not getting the same kind of energy you used to.
Yes, and I don’t really know what I’m supposed to do about that.
You’d like to find a way to deal with this situation where you can’t seem to find energy when you’re with others.
Yes, I want to find a way to handle it.
So you’re in the process of looking for ways to address this.
Right, I’m thinking about what kind of approach might be good.
Even while you’re in the middle of that struggle, I can sense your effort to move forward.
I’d like to think about small things I can try on my own first to improve this situation.
You’re thinking about ways you can try by yourself to improve how things are.
Yes, I want to find ways to feel more confident and comfortable when I’m with other people.
You’re exploring ways to feel more confident and at ease when you’re with others.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been taking up the most space in your mind these days?
These days I feel really disconnected from the people around me, and that’s been taking up a lot of space in my mind.
That sounds really hard. The sense of distance we feel in relationships can really weigh on the heart.
Yes, it really does. I used to feel somewhat positive about spending time with people, but now even making the effort feels burdensome.
So the sense of burden around socializing has gotten bigger.
I feel like this burden I’m feeling will eventually make me grow even more distant from people.
That burden is making relationships harder and seems to be playing a part in creating more distance.
Yeah, and it’s more complicated because I don’t exactly dislike that distance.
I’d like to hear more about why that burden, or that distance, doesn’t feel entirely bad to you.
When I feel that burden, I end up keeping my distance from people, and I feel like that’s the only way my stress will go down.
So you’ve had the experience that keeping some distance from people reduces your stress.
Yes, and those experiences make me feel like I’m becoming a weirder person.
It sounds like it hasn’t been easy to find a way of managing stress that comes from closeness and distance with people.
Yes, even when I try to handle it in my own way, this ongoing sense of distance still weighs on me.
Have you ever found yourself wishing that this distance could shrink a bit?
To be honest, sometimes I do have thoughts like that.
I’m curious what kinds of things you imagine doing when you think about trying to lessen that distance.
I still don’t really know specifically what I should do.
It sounds important to go through a process of slowly finding ways to change the situation.
Yes, I think I’ll need that process.
Through that process, I believe you’ll be able to find ways of coping that really fit you.
Hello, what kind of challenge are you facing?

These days I’m having a hard time adjusting to the new academy I just started going to. There, when we take tests or have questions, we’re supposed to ask the teacher, but every time I try, I get so nervous that I can’t go up and talk, and my whole body just freezes.
You’re feeling a sense of burden about the things that are expected of you in this new environment.
Yes, I think that’s really it. And especially for me, it takes more time than other people for me to get used to a new environment.
You feel that you need your own pace when it comes to adjusting to a new environment.
Yes, and when I want to ask something or do something, it’s really hard for me to speak up.
When you find it hard to speak up, what kinds of thoughts go through your mind?
I just feel like everything is my fault, and I beat myself up, thinking, ‘I shouldn’t be like this.’
You’re holding yourself very responsible while also feeling pressured to change.
Yes, that’s right. But at the same time as feeling pressured about changing, I also want to get out of this situation.
Even in this difficult situation, you’re showing the courage to seek change. That’s really admirable.
Thank you, what you said really helps me.
What kind of first step would you like to take to get out of this situation?
I’m not sure exactly what to do yet, but I’d like to try small things one by one.
You’d like to try small things one by one.
Yes, I want to start with something, anything, and gradually overcome this.
What kind of small step would you like to try?
I think it might be good if I try a short greeting or a simple bit of small talk with the teacher before I ask a question.
So you’d like to try a short greeting or simple conversation with the teacher before asking a question.
Yes, I think that would help me relax a little.
What kind of feeling are you hoping for from that first greeting or conversation?
I think I’ll feel a bit more familiar and comfortable with the teacher, and then asking questions will feel more natural and easier.
What do you think might help you feel that sense of closeness with your teacher more easily?
Maybe if the teacher talks to me first or shows some interest in me, I’ll feel more at ease.
You think you’d feel more comfortable if the teacher starts conversations with you or shows interest in you.
Yes, even those small interactions would be a big help for me.
What other ways do you think there might be to experience that kind of interaction?
I’m thinking of trying to show small bits of interest or give little compliments to the teacher myself.
So you’d like to start by showing small bits of interest or giving compliments to your teacher.
Yes, I think that could help improve my relationship with the teacher.
You think it could help improve your relationship with your teacher.
Hello, have you been going through any difficulties recently?
Hello, these days my life feels repetitive and boring, and I keep feeling a kind of skepticism about my life.
It must have been really hard going through that.
Yes, it’s been really hard.
In your daily life, are there any activities or moments that you feel even slightly help shift your mood?
I feel a bit better when I go for a walk or read a book.
Do you go on walks or read often?
Yes, I try those whenever my heart feels heavy.
So when things feel hard, you seek comfort through walks or reading.
Even so, it hasn’t really gotten much better yet.
Besides walking and reading, are you interested in any other activities?
I’m also interested in listening to music or drawing.
Do you feel ready to start listening to music or drawing?
I haven’t tried it yet, but I’d like to start step by step.
So you have the intention to look for a new kind of joy through music or drawing.
Hello, what kinds of thoughts have been taking up most of your mind lately?
I keep thinking that my relationship with a close friend has really changed.
It must not be easy to go through the process of accepting that change.
Yeah. It really hurts to feel like we can’t go back to how things used to be.
You’re feeling a deep sense of loss because of the change in your relationship with your friend.
Yes, that’s right. It makes me sad to think that I’ve lost the friend I trusted and relied on the most.
The sadness of feeling like you’ve lost a friend you trusted and depended on is really weighing on you.
I’m struggling with how I could improve my relationship with that friend, or if there’s a way to make new friends.
So you’re in a place where you’re thinking a lot about how to repair the relationship or create new connections.
Yes, that’s right. I really don’t know how to approach it.
You’re feeling at a loss because you’re not sure how to reconnect in that relationship or build new ones.
I want to handle this situation in my own way.
I can really hear a strong desire to deal with this situation in your own way.
Yes, I want to regain my confidence.
Your wish to regain your confidence is becoming a very important source of motivation for you.
Hello, what has been weighing on your mind the most recently?
After commuting to and from work, I really don’t want to do anything.
It makes sense that you’d feel that way, since commuting can drain a lot of your energy.
Yeah, once I get home I just lie down and let time pass.
So aside from resting, you’re not really interested in doing much else.
Right, and I haven’t been able to find anything I could be interested in.
So you do have some curiosity about new hobbies or activities, but you just haven’t found what that is yet.
Yes, that’s right. I am curious, but I don’t know what I should be interested in.
So you’re curious, but you haven’t found anything to direct that interest toward.
That’s exactly it. I feel lost about where to pour that curiosity into.
Did you have any hobbies you used to enjoy in the past?
When I was younger, I liked drawing.
Would you like to try starting drawing again?
I would like to, but I feel lost about where to start.
It sounds like you still have affection for drawing, but it’s hard to figure out how or where to begin.
Yes, that’s exactly it. It’s hard to figure out how to get started.
When it comes to drawing, what style or themes are you most interested in?
I’m very interested in drawing landscapes.
What kinds of landscapes would you like to draw?
I want to draw the places I saw while traveling.
Since you want to draw the places you saw on your travels, it seems like you’d like to recall those travel memories and express them through your drawings.
Hello, is there something that’s been weighing on your mind recently?
Hello, yes, there’s something that’s been really hard for me lately. A single comment I heard from an acquaintance I met not long ago really hit me hard.
That one comment is still on your mind.
Yes, it was really unexpected, and because of that comment I felt extremely tense all day long.
Could you explain what that comment meant to you?
Actually, the comment itself wasn’t that bad in terms of its literal meaning. But I think it hit me harder because I heard it when I wasn’t ready to admit I was at fault and move on.
Hearing that when you weren’t ready at the time really stirred up your feelings.
Yes, that’s exactly it. Even though it was the kind of thing that normally wouldn’t be a big deal, my feelings were really hurt.
So your feelings were deeply hurt by something you normally wouldn’t pay much attention to.
That’s right. Since then, the tension and anxiety I feel have gotten worse.
Since that incident, your tension and anxiety have increased.
Yes, I tried to get myself out of that state, but it wasn’t easy.
You tried to get out of that situation.
Yes, but those efforts didn’t really help.
Despite your efforts, things didn’t get better easily.
Yes, so I want to find a way to feel at least a bit better.
You’d like to improve your current situation.
Yes, I’m hoping things will get even a little better.
Even with the difficulties you’re facing now, I can see a willingness to try to change things in a positive direction.
Yes, that’s right, I started thinking that I want to change the situation.
Your intention to change the situation will play an important role.
Hello, what kinds of things have been weighing on your mind lately?
Hello, I keep feeling burdened by how I always get nervous in front of people and am really shy with strangers.
It sounds like you’re experiencing quite a bit of anxiety in social situations.
Yes, especially when I’m with people I don’t know or in a new environment, the tension gets really intense.
In what kinds of situations or activities do you feel a bit more at ease?
Actually, when I’m focused on something or doing my hobbies, my mind naturally feels more relaxed.
Then how might you be able to extend that sense of ease you feel when you’re focused or doing hobbies into other parts of your daily life?
Hmm, I could try giving myself positive messages and slowly work on getting used to new environments.
Your efforts to get used to new environments could help you feel more confident than before.
I think so too. I want to keep trying little by little and gradually reduce this tension.
The way you’re thinking about how to reduce your tension, and quietly trying to put it into action, is really admirable.
I’m starting to feel hopeful that I might be able to get better, even if it’s just little by little.
So you’re hoping to get better step by step.
Yes, and as I go through the process of working toward change, I find myself expecting positive outcomes.
I’m really struck by your attitude of working toward change and looking forward to positive results.
Thank you. I’m going to try to trust myself and take on challenges one by one.
The experiences you gain as you trust yourself and take on those challenges will definitely be helpful.
